hypothesis: One source-blind, fitted two-prototype, 4-output direct-write public residual program with a bounded Bayesian evidence gate based on the last <=5 public residuals and training-only inferred persistent stay probability will produce persistent held later-step RMSE <=0.08 and IID switching regret over fully trained static WSP160 <=0.01 for each of three frozen seeds; unseen p_stay=.8 and action-conditioned rotated amplitude worlds are independent stress tests, with numeric improvement or failure recorded. A separately trained fully fitted conventional Bayesian persistence-vs-IID control may tie or win. This is an explicitly falsifiable source-free prototype, NOT scientific first-use or claim of new mathematical algorithm.

protocol.fitted_source: For each seed use inherited WSP163 fixtures(seed), 32×16 FIT persistent episodes only (512 public rows), 16×16 held persistent VAL episodes and 16×16 IID stress; other held structurally changed evaluation episodes generated with random.Random(seed+9000), random.Random(seed+12000), each 16×16 rows with 4D identical visible input context support; no external simulator imports.
held_domains: persistent: original WSP163 authored two-offset process fixed hidden sign within each 16-step episode, new noise/episodes
iid: original WSP163 authored sign changes independently each step
moderate: new held domain public law same observed base public input with latent sign switch probability 0.20 each step, 4D offset train magnitude (0.20,-0.15,0.10,-0.05), sigma .02

rotated-action: new held domain with latent sign staying with probability 0.8 but each chosen public action reverses AND rotates offset to (0.05,0.18,-0.20,0.12), sigma .02; structurally altered unseen simulated rule
protocol.train_budget: Each seed 512 FIT public observations, first-only self-supervised mode assignments based on FIT public residual first coordinate >=0, two 4D mean prototypes directly written with bounded counts, training-only stay prior Beta(1,1) from pairs of inferred mode signs, NO hidden regime labels, no post-FIT updates at validation.
protocol.representation: ONE 4x10 frozen WSP160 static baseline from FIT plus ONE shared bounded 2x4 residual prototype direct-write table, one Beta-smoothed fitted stay probability, max public memory 5 prior transitions, no per-family expert bank or hidden source flag. Single 3KB canonical integrity-bound checkpoint containing frozen static weights and prototype scalars. No gradient training.
protocol.inference: For latest prior N<=5 public residuals from same episode, infer mode signs via closest of two fitted prototypes, use posterior evidence for persistent vs iid based on public adjacent sign transition likelihood, prior P(persistent)=0.5, Bayes factor over all available adjacent transitions; expectation of next residual = mixture weight × (2*p_stay-1) × most-recent public inferred mode prototype deviation + fitted center; no previous outcome on first step. In no prior or terminal reset return static. Do not condition on future/current observed next state.

decision.transfer: Novel moderate switch: require native later-step RMSE lower than static by >=0.015 for all 3 seeds for TRANSFER_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL.
